violations.why: Anchor (prio 6) can preempt summit between its write and read of v_falcon and change the value.
Thorn (prio 3) preempts summit (prio 2) between the write and read and writes v_falcon.
Anchor preempts kelp between the index read and the increment, so the read in v_prism++ sees a different value.
Anchor's increment can land between kelp's read and its write-back, and the write-back overwrites it.
Anchor preempts thorn after it reads v_prism and before it resets v_prism.
Kelp (prio 5) preempts thorn after it reads v_prism and before it resets v_prism.
